llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究马氏体钢300的选择性激光熔化工艺，未涉及生物医学植入物或多孔结构，与AM生物医学材料方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对马氏体钢300力学性能的影响机制。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数，测试试样的拉伸和硬度性能。
summary_zh.result: 发现了工艺参数与致密度、强度之间的关联规律。
summary_zh.validation: 进行了拉伸测试和硬度测试验证工艺优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting parameters on the mechanical properties of maraging steel 300.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser power and scanning speed, followed by tensile and hardness testing of fabricated specimens.
summary_en.result: Correlations between processing parameters and mechanical properties such as density and strength were established.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements was performed to validate the effects of process parameters.

papers.title: Data on the surface morphology of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V implants during processing by plasma electrolytic oxidation
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V implants were biofunctionalized using plasma electrolytic oxidation. At various time points during this process scanning electron microscopy imaging was performed to analyze the surface morphology (van Hengel et al., 2017) [1]. This data shows the changes in surface morphology during plasma electrolytic oxidation. Data presented in this article are related to the research article "Selective laser melting porous metallic implants with immobilized silver nanoparticles kill and prevent biofilm formation by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus" (van Hengel et al., 2017) [1].

summary_en.motivation: To provide surface morphology data of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V implants during plasma electrolytic oxidation.
